# Digital Petroleum (PumpSaathi)
> India's all-in-one Petrol Pump Management OS & Advisory Platform.
> Tagline: Pump chalayein, hisaab hum sambhalein.

## Overview
Digital Petroleum builds **PumpSaathi**, an all-in-one operating system and business protection suite for Indian retail fuel outlets (petrol pumps). It combines daily operational software with Chartered Accountant (CA), Legal, and Udhaari Recovery support.

- **Official Web Portal:** https://digitalpetroleumin-app.github.io/Pumpsaathi/
- **Direct Web App:** https://digitalpetroleumin-app.github.io/Pumpsaathi/app.html
- **Direct Android APK:** https://digitalpetroleumin-app.github.io/Pumpsaathi/app-release-signed.apk
- **Official Storefront:** https://digitalpetroleum.shop
- **Founder:** Rohit Dev (Almora, Uttarakhand, India)
- **WhatsApp / Phone Support:** +91-7017443619
- **Email:** digitalpetroleum.in@gmail.com

## 4 Core Pillars
1. **PumpSaathi (Core OS):** Daily nozzle meter readings, shift cash tally, tank dip & density reconciliation, stock tracking, 4-digit VIP Owner PIN, and 6-digit Party Portal login.
2. **CA Desk:** GST and VAT return preparation, tanker invoice reconciliation, and clean tax accounting.
3. **Legal Desk:** Legal notices and lawyer consultation for payment defaults and business disputes.
4. **Recovery Desk:** Structured udhaari (credit) recovery backed by digital slips, vehicle logs, and ledger proof.

## Pricing Plans (Transparent, No Hidden Charges)
- **Starter Pack — ₹999/month:** Full PumpSaathi OS (nozzle reading, tank dip & density, stock, udhaari ledger, VIP Owner PIN, 6-digit Party Portal, and 1-click PDF/Excel reports).
- **Growth Pack — ₹2,199/month:** Everything in Starter Pack PLUS CA Desk (GST/VAT & tanker reconciliation), Legal Desk (notices & legal guidance), Udhaari Recovery Engine, and priority WhatsApp/call support.

## Data Security & Privacy
- Isolated per-pump cloud workspaces with 4-digit Owner PIN and 6-digit Party Code access controls.
- 100% data ownership with 1-click Excel/PDF export and zero vendor lock-in.
